d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam special tyohaar, party, function ke lie recipe le ke aaya hu Chole Puri kaise banae ye video me share karunga, ye new tarika hai poori banane ka jisse na sari puri ekdam tender aur crispy aur khasta banti hai, aur 100% fulegi, ekdam dhaba aur halwai log mote atte se puri banate hai na woi result aaega, aur chole apan log Punjabi Masala Style me banaenge, jo halwai log function me tari wale banate hai na aloo chole ki sabji waise hi :)
Ingredients for Punjabi Chole Masala -
250g chole, (8-10 hour soak karna hai)
Salt - namak
Baking Soda - 1/4 tsp
